\subsection*{Turing Machine --- Build --- Contract --- Catalog: Introduction}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Contract.Catalog}.

\subsection*{Turing Machine --- Build --- Contract --- Catalog: Results}

\begin{definition}[Contract for clearing a work tape]
\lean{Turing.clearTM_contract}
\label{Turing.clearTM_contract}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Contract, Turing.FinTM.bufferTape, Turing.clearTM, Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg}
For a $k$-tape machine, a tape index $i$, and an input word $x$, consider the clearing
machine that sweeps right over the stored word and then rewinds while erasing it. For
each word $w$ and eligible starting configuration $d$ in the sweep state, require that
tape $i$ contains the buffer encoding of $w$ at every offset $p$ from $-1$ through
$|w|$. The machine finishes after exactly $2|w|+2$ steps in the done state; it clears
tape $i$ on the cells from the starting head position through the cell immediately
before that position plus $|w|$, leaves other tapes unchanged, and all work-head
positions stay within the stated envelope: on tape $i$ from one cell left of the
starting position through the starting position plus $|w|$, and on every other tape at
its starting position.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Frame property of the clearing contract]
\lean{Turing.clearTM_contract_frames}
\label{Turing.clearTM_contract_frames}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Contract.Frames, Turing.clearTM_contract}
\difficulty{4}
For every natural number $k$, every work-tape index $i<k$, and every input word $x$ over
an alphabet $\Gamma$, the contract for clearing tape $i$ has the following frame
property: for each word $w$ and each starting configuration $d$ in the sweep state that
satisfies the contract's precondition, the endpoint agrees with $d$ on every work-tape
cell outside the set that, on tape $i$, is the half-open interval from the initial head
position through the position just before the initial head position plus $|w|$, and, on
every other tape, is empty.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Head positions on other tapes remain fixed]
\lean{Turing.clearTM_contract_traj}
\label{Turing.clearTM_contract_traj}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Contract.Traj, Turing.clearTM_contract}
\difficulty{3}
For every natural number $k$, alphabet $\Gamma$, input word $x$ over $\Gamma$, and
work-tape index $i<k$, consider the contract for clearing tape $i$. For every word $w$
and every starting configuration $d$ in the sweep state satisfying the contract's
precondition, at every natural-number time $u$ up to and including the contract's
prescribed running time, each tape $j\ne i$ has its head at the same position as in $d$.
\end{theorem}
